Q1: Furan's hazard profile indicates known significant hazards (Tier 1) for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, and reproductive toxicity (CMR), inhalation (IHL), oral (ORL), and organ/systemic (OGN) hazards, based on the Globally Harmonized System (GHS). It also shows an expanded perspective (Tier 2) for environmental (ENV) and dermal/eye (SKN) hazards, drawing on more current scientific data. Endocrine disruption hazards (EDC) are categorized as having a demonstrated low to moderate hazard (Tier 3).
